facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: £210K at inception if invested + up to £330K ARC follow-on commitment; up to £500K total commitment
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: Investment decision during residency; ARC matches qualifying professional-investor round within 9 months
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: £125K for 8.5% equity + £85K MFN convertible note; £40K service fee deducted from initial funding. ARC can add £165K/£330K depending on qualifying round size.
facts_raw.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: Founder must have UK work right or active visa application by first interview; Antler does not invest in solo founders at investment point.
facts_raw.Can Apply Solo: Yes to residency; No to investment unless founding team formed
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Full-time, in-person residency; inception-stage founder; if already raised a meaningful pre-seed, likely too late.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: Up to 8 weeks in-person in London; founders typically 4–6 days/week in person; investment teams continue 10–12 weeks post-investment.
facts_raw.Duration: 8 weeks + up to 10–12 week build/raise phase
facts_raw.International Founder: Yes, subject to UK work-right/visa progress
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Pre-seed 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司
facts_raw.Notes: Apply early; start date is not deadline.
